verdict.rationale: TrueLayer documents JSON webhook notifications for Payments API v3 events such as payment status changes. You configure a webhook URI per app in Console, and incoming requests carry a `Tl-Signature` that you verify with the official signing libraries. The main limits are that each app gets only a single webhook URI and the evidence shows no per-event subscription filtering. Missing for 10: selective per-event subscription or multiple endpoints, documented retry/delivery guarantees, webhook coverage beyond Payments API v3, independent or hands-on corroboration.
